newsitem.title: PERU: Peruvian plane crashes in Pacific, killing 200.
newsitem.headline: Peruvian plane crashes in Pacific, killing 200.

text.p: An AeroPeru Boeing 747 crashed early on Wednesday in the Pacific Ocean south of the Peruvian capital of Lima, killing all 200 people on board, fire officials said.
"Tragically, by all appearances, there were no survivors," fire department spokeswoman Zoraida Reyes Rodriquez said.

The plane, which had left Lima for Chile, suffered "mechanical defects" and reported an emergency at 1:34 a.m. (0634 GMT) before apparently trying to turn back to the Peruvian capital when it crashed, Reyes added.
Originally, fire officials said the plane was coming from Miami but later withdrew that statement.
Rescue workers said a helicopter flying over the scene of the crash had identified some lights in the sea, but was being hindered by heavy fog.
It would be the worst air accident in Peruvian history folowing the deaths of 123 people in a Faucett Airline crash near Peru's second city, Arequipa, earlier this year.
